metalcraft.shadows.shadow_distance.toolt: Distance for detailed sun and moon shadows. Beyond this, distant shadows keep larger terrain shadows at lower cost when their distance is set higher.
metalcraft.shadows.distant_shadow_distan: Extend softer, lower-detail sun and moon shadows beyond the detailed range. Uses terrain already loaded as ordinary chunks; does not load extra chunks. Set to 0, or at/below the detailed distance, to disable.
metalcraft.options.title: MetalCraft Settings
metalcraft.options.display.title: Display & Performance
metalcraft.options.terrain.title: Terrain & Distance
metalcraft.lod.summary: Total view distance is Video Settings → Render Distance (now %s chunks). Chunks inside the native distance are ordinary chunks; beyond it, lightweight distant terrain fills the rest of the view.
metalcraft.lod.status.building: Building distant terrain: %s areas left (%s drawn, %s MiB).
metalcraft.lod.status.ready: Ready: starts when you enter a singleplayer world.
metalcraft.lod.status.disabled: Off: Render Distance loads ordinary chunks.
metalcraft.lod.status.not_metal: Inactive: needs the Metal graphics API, but this session uses %s. Set Video Settings → Graphics API to Default and restart.
metalcraft.lod.status.render_distance: Inactive: Render Distance (%s) must be larger than the native distance (%s).
metalcraft.lod.status.multiplayer: Inactive in multiplayer: the server decides the view distance.
metalcraft.lod.status.ceiling: Native distance only: this dimension has a ceiling.
metalcraft.lod.enabled.tooltip: Draw terrain between the native distance and the render distance from compact models built in the background from the world generator and from chunks you have loaded. Only the native distance is loaded, simulated and meshed as ordinary chunks. Off restores ordinary chunk loading out to the render distance.
metalcraft.lod.native_distance.tooltip: Radius of ordinary, full-quality chunks (entities, block entities, caves and exact blocks). Beyond it, distant terrain is drawn. Smaller values are faster; has no effect when the render distance is not larger.
metalcraft.lod.detail.tooltip: How slowly distant terrain loses detail. Each step pushes every detail level about 1.5x farther away, adding geometry, memory and build time. 5 keeps a distant cell to roughly six pixels at 1080p. Nearby distant terrain is drawn with real block textures and shading, like ordinary chunks, out to 256 blocks at 5, 320 at 6, 384 at 7 and 512 at 8 (64 at 3, 128 at 4, none below).
metalcraft.lod.limits: Single-player on Metal. Distant terrain shows the surface only: trees are approximated where chunks have not been loaded yet, and caves, entities and interiors appear inside the native distance. Dimensions with a ceiling show the native distance only.
metalcraft.options.shaders.title: Shader Packs
metalcraft.options.shader_no_options: This shader pack has no settings.
metalcraft.options.half_resolution.descr: Render at macOS logical resolution instead of the Retina display's 2x backing resolution. The image is upscaled to the native Metal surface for a substantial GPU performance gain.
metalcraft.options.half_resolution.toolt: Halves each framebuffer dimension, reducing the rendered pixel count to one quarter.
metalcraft.options.unlocked_frame_rate.t: Presents without display synchronization and ignores Minecraft's Max Framerate and one-minute AFK limits, so frames are not paced to the display's refresh rate. Iconified, ten-minute idle, and menu throttles still apply.
metalcraft.water.water_enabled.tooltip: Animated water, reflections, absorption, foam, and underwater distortion. Off restores the original water appearance.
metalcraft.water.water_wave_strength.too: Surface ripple strength. Zero keeps the water surface normal still.
metalcraft.water.water_refraction_streng: Background distortion through water. Zero removes distortion while preserving depth absorption.
metalcraft.water.water_absorption.toolti: How strongly depth colors and dims the view through water. Zero keeps background transmission clear.
metalcraft.water.water_foam.tooltip: Restrained foam at shallow contacts. Zero disables foam.
metalcraft.water.water_underwater_distor: Mild distortion of the world while submerged. Zero disables distortion; underwater fog remains.
metalcraft.water.water_reflection_qualit: Baseline reflects the sky and sun. Screen-space tiers also reflect visible opaque objects, at extra cost. Off-screen and transparent objects use the baseline fallback.
metalcraft.water.water_detail_distance.t: Range of detailed water waves. Larger waves preserve distant reflections. Limited to loaded terrain; tiny ripples remain filtered to reduce shimmer.
metalcraft.water.water_detail.tooltip: Fine surface ripples. None retains broad waves; higher levels add smaller ripples. Larger waves retain distant surface detail.
metalcraft.options.clear_distance_fog.to: Keeps distant terrain clear in fair weather by pushing distance fog beyond the loaded view. Water, lava, snow, weather and status-effect fog remain. Applies immediately on Metal.
metalcraft.wind.wind_enabled.tooltip: Animate tree leaves, grass and ferns. Grass stays anchored at its roots; shadows follow the motion.
metalcraft.wind.wind_strength.tooltip: How far foliage bends in the wind. 100% is a gentle breeze; 0% keeps plants still.
